entities.summary: Vladimir Bogoevski is a Yugoslav volleyball player from Skopje, North Macedonia. He competed for Yugoslavia in the volleyball men's tournament at the 1980 Summer Olympics. He is the sport director of the Olympic Committee of North Macedonia.
